props.description: When you cast an instantaneous spell, if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you may increase the spell's total MP cost by up to 【SL × 10】 Mind Points. If you do so and the spell deals damage to one or more creatures, it will deal 5 extra damage to each creature for every 10 Mind Points by which you increased its total MP cost.

0.menu_option_descriptions: Spend 10 MP for +5 damage to each creature|Spend 20 MP for +10 damage to each creature|Spend 30 MP for +15 damage to each creature
0.menu_option_labels: +10 MP → +5 damage|+20 MP → +10 damage|+30 MP → +15 damage
0.menu_subtitle: Increase the spell's MP cost for extra damage

1.condition_formula: SL >= 1 && ((ACTION_IS_FREE_CAST == 0 && CUR_MP >= ACTION_COST_MP + ceil(10 * (100 - FLAG_CATACLYSM_COST_DISCOUNT) / 100)) || (ACTION_IS_FREE_CAST == 1 && AE_CHARGES_BIMAGUS_ENCORE + (AE_COUNT_BIMAGUS_ENCORE == 0) * AE_CHARGES_BIMAGUS >= ACTION_COST_MP + ceil(10 * (100 - FLAG_CATACLYSM_COST_DISCOUNT) / 100)))
1.prompt_label: Overcharge: increase MP cost (+5 damage per 10 MP)
1.prompt_max: min( FLAG_CATACLYSM_MP_CAP + (FLAG_CATACLYSM_MP_CAP == 0) * (SL * 10), floor(((ACTION_IS_FREE_CAST == 0) * (CUR_MP - ACTION_COST_MP) + (ACTION_IS_FREE_CAST == 1) * (AE_CHARGES_BIMAGUS_ENCORE + (AE_COUNT_BIMAGUS_ENCORE == 0) * AE_CHARGES_BIMAGUS - ACTION_COST_MP)) / ((100 - FLAG_CATACLYSM_COST_DISCOUNT) / 100) / 10) * 10 )

4.condition_formula: SL >= 2 && ((ACTION_IS_FREE_CAST == 0 && CUR_MP >= ACTION_COST_MP + ceil(20 * (100 - FLAG_CATACLYSM_COST_DISCOUNT) / 100)) || (ACTION_IS_FREE_CAST == 1 && AE_CHARGES_BIMAGUS_ENCORE + (AE_COUNT_BIMAGUS_ENCORE == 0) * AE_CHARGES_BIMAGUS >= ACTION_COST_MP + ceil(20 * (100 - FLAG_CATACLYSM_COST_DISCOUNT) / 100)))

7.condition_formula: SL >= 3 && ((ACTION_IS_FREE_CAST == 0 && CUR_MP >= ACTION_COST_MP + ceil(30 * (100 - FLAG_CATACLYSM_COST_DISCOUNT) / 100)) || (ACTION_IS_FREE_CAST == 1 && AE_CHARGES_BIMAGUS_ENCORE + (AE_COUNT_BIMAGUS_ENCORE == 0) * AE_CHARGES_BIMAGUS >= ACTION_COST_MP + ceil(30 * (100 - FLAG_CATACLYSM_COST_DISCOUNT) / 100)))

props.name: Cataclysm

0.condition_formula: HAS_ARCANE_WEAPON == 1 && ACTION_IS_SPELL == 1 && ACTION_DURATION == 0 && ((ACTION_IS_FREE_CAST == 0 && CUR_MP >= ACTION_COST_MP + ceil(10 * (100 - FLAG_CATACLYSM_COST_DISCOUNT) / 100)) || (ACTION_IS_FREE_CAST == 1 && AE_CHARGES_BIMAGUS_ENCORE + (AE_COUNT_BIMAGUS_ENCORE == 0) * AE_CHARGES_BIMAGUS >= ACTION_COST_MP + ceil(10 * (100 - FLAG_CATACLYSM_COST_DISCOUNT) / 100)))
